rationale.RoomsPerHousehold: Living space per occupant - stronger comfort proxy than raw AveRooms.
rationale.BedroomRatio: Bedrooms as a fraction of total rooms - low ratio often signals larger, higher-value homes.
rationale.DistanceToCoast: Approximate distance to the coastline, proxy for the documented coastal price premium.
rationale.IncomePerRoom: Interaction between affluence and living space.
